description: This file contains a mock implementation of a storage provider for testing Orleans grain storage, including extension methods for adding test storage providers and the MockStorageProvider class with CRUD and command execution functionalities.

classes.name: MockStorageProvider
classes.description: A mock implementation of an Orleans grain storage provider used for testing purposes, supporting state management and control commands.

methods.name: AddTestStorageProvider
methods.description: Extension method to add a test storage provider to the Orleans silo builder.

methods.name: MockStorageProvider
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the mock storage provider with specified configurations.

methods.name: GetProviderState
methods.description: Returns current state counts and initialization metrics.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the mock storage for a specific grain state.

methods.name: GetLastState
methods.description: Retrieves the last stored state object.

methods.name: GetLastState<T>
methods.description: Retrieves the last stored state with specific type.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the storage provider (increments close count and clears state).

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes management/control commands against the storage provider.
